title: Mangrove Forests Lost 3.6 Million Hectares
hook: Mangrove loss slowed, but coastlines already lost a vast natural shield.
closing: Slower loss helps, but missing mangroves still leave coastal communities exposed.
question: Can protection catch up?

segments.say: Mangrove forest area fell to 15.2 million hectares, stripping away part of coastlines' natural storm barrier.
Asia lost 1.9 million hectares of mangrove forest, the largest regional loss shown.
Annual mangrove loss slowed to 102 thousand hectares. Protection can reduce destruction before it fully stops.
